invariants.rationale: Methods typically expect non-null arguments; this ensures that the order reference is valid before processing.
Order quantity should be non-negative, reflecting realistic ordering scenarios and constraints from domain modeling.
Unit price of an item should be non-negative for valid orders, as negative prices are generally not meaningful in commercial contexts.
Assumes a reasonable upper bound on order sizes to prevent overflow or unreasonable processing loads.
Places an upper bound on unit price to prevent outlier values that could indicate input errors.
